text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Rem decided to become an "otherworld researcher" for summer beach-like activities. The first thing she chose to do was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『夏の海』をリサーチすることになったレム。
最初に選んだ遊びは──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Hold your thumb on top and the remaining four fingers on the bottom...
text_block_list.orig_text:
親指を、
上に、
残りの４本の指は下から……
握る。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Is this how the correct grip is?
text_block_list.orig_text: 握り方はこれで合っていますか？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I suppose this is merely the basics of fishing in the sea. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが『海釣り』の基本なんですね。
ですが──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Is it possible to catch a fish in such a vast area of water where you can't even see the bottom?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この、
底すら見えない広大な海の中から、
お魚を釣り上げることなんてできるんでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That worries me a little. But it is also true I've heard everyone having a lot of fun doing this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不安はあります。
ですが、
皆様から楽しさも色々とお聞きしています。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: "If we talk about the sea of Landosol, fishing in it is a must. The local fishes are especially active in the summer", That's what the customers at the beach house told me, and it seems they found it very satisfying to catch fishes too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの海といえば海釣り。
特に夏は
お魚の活動が活発で、
たくさん釣れて楽しい、
と、
海の家のお客様たちも話されていましたから。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: And that's why Rem is here experiencing it first, to make sure Subaru and the others will surely have fun doing this, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからこそ、
スバルくんたちにも楽しんでもらいたいと、
まずはレムがこうして体験させてもらっているのですが……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm standing in front of this vast ocean, I'm worrying and wondering if a beginner like Rem can really do this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いざこうして、
広い海を目の前にすると、
初心者のレムに本当にできるのでしょうかと、
不安に。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I'll be counting on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます。
頼りにしてますね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, hmm, so you've got to hold up the rod... and swing it up as if you were throwing something far away... correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふむふむ、
竿を構えて……
遠くに物を放るように、
振りかぶる……
ですね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Could this technique be... No, I should be giving it a try first... HYAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはもしや……
いえ、
まずはやってみます。
──やあっ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: EEEHHH?! I-I'm so sorry! Was that wrong...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？　
す、
すみません！
間違っていたでしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Really...?! That's reassuring. I thought it felt similar to a tool I always use!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当ですか……！
よかった。
いつも使っている道具と
感触が似ていると思ったんです！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: A spiked iron ball for self-defense.
text_block_list.orig_text: 護身用の鉄球です。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: So all that's left is wait for the fish to bite. When you get a bite, adjust the rod, and when the hook gets caught, pull the fish out... I feel like I understand it in words, but putting it into practice is different...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは釣れるのを待つんですね。
アタリが来たら竿を合わせて、
針が引っ掛かったら釣り上げる……
言葉ではわかっていても、
実際にやるのは難しそうです。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは──！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: My rod suddenly feels heavy to handle. Does this qualify as a "catch"?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に
竿が重くなりました。
これがアタリですか！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: When I get a catch, adjust the rod and pull it up──YAAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタリが来たら竿を合わせて、
そのまま釣り上げる──
やぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Ah... I caught it...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
釣れました……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Look, it's a reasonably sized fish! It looks like it would be delicious if cooked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
手頃な大きさのお魚です！
お料理したら美味しそうですね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I believe this is my first time, you know? I was in a hurry this time and pulled the fish out without reeling it in. Next time, I'll stay calm and do as you taught me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初めてですよ？
先ほどは焦って
リールを巻かずにそのまま釣り上げてしまいました。
次は落ち着いて、
教えていただいた通りにやってみます。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Putting the bait back on and... Going for the second throw!
text_block_list.orig_text:
餌を付けて、
と。
二投目、
行きます！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Just like when throwing my iron ball... EIGH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
鉄球を投げるように……
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This fish is about three times bigger than the last one. It should be enough to fill everyone's stomachs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度のお魚は
先ほどの三倍ほどの大きさがありましたね。
これなら皆様をお腹いっぱいにできそうです。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I'm sure this is merely a coincidence. I'm fairly sure that both Subaru-kun and Sister might be able to catch something even better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまたまですよ。
スバルくんや姉様は
もっともっと上手に釣れるのではないかと。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...But, perhaps, does this mean... the farther you cast, that is, the further out to sea your rod goes, the greater your chances of catching a big fish?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
これはもしかして……
遠くに投げれば投げるほど、
つまり
沖に行けば行くほど、
大きな魚が釣れる可能性が上がる、
ということでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I knew it that was the case.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど。
やっぱりそうなんですね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Thinking about it... Subaru-kun is a boy, so I'm sure he'd probably want to catch something big.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おそらく……
スバルくんは男の子ですから、
きっと大物を狙いたがると思うんです。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: By all means!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぜひ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Amazing. Whichever way I turn around and looks it's just the sea, the sea, everywhere's the sea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいです。
どちらを向いても
海、
海、
海。
海しか見えません！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: And this vehicle called a "fishing boat." It can run so fast on the water... There's no doubt such an experience would make Subaru-kun happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
この
『漁船』という乗り物。
水の上をこんなに早く走れるなんて……
スバルくんが喜ぶのは間違いありません。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: In order not to waste the kindness of those who let her and you on board despite her sudden request, Rem will make sure she learns how to play "boat fishing" properly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
急なお願いにもかかわらず
船に乗せてくださった方々の
ご厚意を無駄にしないためにも、
レムは『船釣り』の遊び方をしっかりと身に付けてみせます！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Heh... Or so I'd like to think, but...

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Doppaaaan!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドッッパァァァァン！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: There's a sudden change in the wind! ROUGH WAVES ARE COMING!
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に時化てきやがった！
横波が来るぞー！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: The ship is going to be washed away!
text_block_list.orig_text: 船が流されてます！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: If we keep going like this we'll run aground! Pull up all the anchors and nets!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃ座礁だ！
いかりも網も、
いったん全部揚げろーー！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: The boat is rocking and swaying all over, are we going to be fine...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
船もぐらぐらと揺れて、
大丈夫でしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, young lady and boy over there! You're in danger if you stay here. I'm not judging you or anything but, take shelter in the captain's cabin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
そこの嬢ちゃん坊ちゃん！
ここにいちゃ命はねぇぜ。
悪いことは言わねぇ、
船長室に避難しろ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: And what about you all? What are you going to do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
皆様はどうされるんです？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: I'm not inexperienced enough to need an amateur to worry about me! Just hurry up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
素人に心配してもらうほど、
場数踏んでなくねぇんだよ！　
いいから急げ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Understood. Well then, for now let us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかりました。
ではここはひとまず──

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeeeeek! Wh-Wha, between the waves... L-LOOK AT THAT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ、
ひぃぃぃぃぃ！
な、
波間に……
あれを見ろ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: What......did you just say......? That gigantic fish shadow... Isn't it the Blue Grim Reaper? What the hell, at a time like this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なん……
だって……？　
あのバカでかい魚影は……
『青の死神』じゃねぇか！
なんてこった、
こんな時に……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: The Blue Grim Reaper?
text_block_list.orig_text: 青の死神？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's the giant fish that's famous around here for ramming boats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
この辺りじゃ有名な、
船に体当たりを食らわす
超巨大魚さ。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: There's a lot of us, especially my friends, who've had a bout against that monster and had their boats destroyed...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつとやりあって、
船ごと蹴っ散らかされた仲間が、
山ほどいやがる。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: In this storm, if that Grim Reaper catches our eye, we're finished! Let's get away! Full starboard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな時化の中、
死神に目ぇつけられちゃお仕舞ぇだ！
逃げるぞ！　
面舵一杯ー！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's no good! We won't make it in time...! HE'S GOING TO SLAM ON OUR SIDE! BOY, GIRL, YOU TWO GET READY FOR IMPACT TOO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──いやだめだ！　
間に合わねぇ……！
横っ腹に体当たりがくるぞ！
お前らも衝撃に備えろ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Just a little more... I-I can't hold on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
く
っ……！
あと、
ちょっと……
と、
どかな──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Eek...!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ……！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: AAAAHHHH?! THAT BLUE HAIRED LADY BODY IS...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あああ！？
青髪の姉ちゃんの体が……！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: She's flying off...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 宙を舞っ……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Rem's body flies through the air above the raging waves. At that time, {0} regrets having let Rem board the fishing boat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
荒れ狂う波の上に、
宙を舞うレムの体。
{0}がレムを漁船に乗せたことを後悔した──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: However, right then...
text_block_list.orig_text: その次の瞬間。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Kh! You have nothing to worry about!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
ご心配には、
及びません！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman One & Two
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: おおおぅ！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hm! Kh!

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はっ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: She kicked off the roof of the pilothouse... and landed on the deck?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
操舵室の屋根を蹴って……
甲板に着地したぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: What a bunch of crazy moves...
text_block_list.orig_text: なんて身のこなしだ……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Whew, somehow I managed to make it back! ...Excuse me, but which is the longest fishing rod on this boat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとか戻ってこられました！
──すみませんが、
この船で一番長い竿はどれですか？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, t-this one is... WAIT, WHAT ARE YOU DOING YOUNG LADY?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？　
あ、
こ、
これだけど……
って、
なにをするつもりだ
嬢ちゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Rem just had an idea.
text_block_list.orig_text: レムに考えがあります。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I have to swing it and... HAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
振りかぶって……
はぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: EEEHHHH?! Lady, are you trying to catch the Blue Grim Reaper?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！？
まさか姉ちゃん、
死神を釣ろうってのか！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I was taught the basics of boat fishing by {0} already. And... if I can learn the tricks of catching such a big fish right here, I'll be able to teach Subaru step by step too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
船釣りの基本はお教えいただきました。
それに……
ここで大物を釣るコツが習得できれば、
スバルくんに手取り足取り教えてあげられますから。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: This also prevents your ship from being attacked, so it kills two birds with one stone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
船が襲われるのも防げて、
一石二鳥です！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: WHO THE HELL CARES ABOUT SUBARU-KUN?! That fish is not the kind you want to make an enemy of, much less make your catch! You'll end up getting us all drawn in! Stop it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰だよスバルくんて！
獲物にするような相手じゃねぇ！
引き込まれるのがオチだ！　
やめとけ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Come on, I've got some tasty-looking bait here. Catch already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
美味しそうな餌がありますよ。
来なさい──！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: STOP LURING ITTTTTTTT!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 招き寄せんなぁぁぁぁ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I've got it!
text_block_list.orig_text: アタリました！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman One & Two
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAAAAA?!
text_block_list.orig_text: んなぁぁぁぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I just have to stick to the basics, adjust the rod... and reel it in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
基本に忠実に、
竿を合わせて……
巻き上げます！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman One & Two
text_block_list.text: IMPOSSIBLE!!
text_block_list.orig_text: バカなーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: No, but to think you'd actually catch that Blue Grim Reaper... And thanks to you Young Lady, all of those fishermen in the boat survived!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやまさか、
本当に
『青の死神』を釣り上げちまうとは……
嬢ちゃんのお陰で、
漁師全員命拾いだ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: You're an amazing fisherman, young lady... No, I can't merely call you a "young lady" anymore, you're a legendary fisherman! Hey, Legend, why don't you become part of our boat of fishermen?
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬢ちゃんすげぇ腕だよ……
いや
もう嬢ちゃんじゃねぇ、
レジェンド漁師だよ！
なぁレジェンド、
うちの船で漁師やんねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to receive such praise. However, Rem already has a job as a maid,
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなにお褒めいただいて、
光栄です。
ですが
レムにはメイドというお仕事がありますので。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: A MAID?! Wait, can you even put that massive strength of yours in maid work?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
メイドぉ！？
あんた
その身体能力、
メイド仕事に活かせんのかい！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Of course, just like boat fishing, being a maid is a profound subject. And Rem is still inexperienced. Every day she tries to follow in the footsteps of her sister, who is her role model.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
船釣り同様、
メイドは奥が深いんです。
それに
レムはまだまだ未熟者。
お手本である姉様の背中を追いかける毎日です。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Being a maid sure sounds like a tough job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メイドってのは、
大変な仕事なんだなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: Then next time, come fishing with that 'Subaru-kun'. Since you're the Legend, we'll let you on the ship anytime.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ今度はぜひ、
その『すばるくん』と一緒に、
釣りにおいで。
レジェンドならいつだって船に乗せてやっから。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうした？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Could this activity of "boat fishing" be a little too dangerous as a summery beach-like game to introduce to Subaru-kun and the others...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この船釣り、
ひょっとして、
スバルくんたちに紹介する海の遊びとしては、
少々危険すぎるでしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Dangerous?
text_block_list.orig_text: 危険？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: Well, it's true that nobody knows exactly can happen... Maybe it's dangerous if you were to put it that way... But...hey.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
何があるかわかんねぇからなぁ……
危険といわれりゃ、
そうかもしれねぇが……
だけど……
なぁ。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Hey, boy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
なぁ、
兄ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's exactly right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
その通り。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: With Rem-chan right next to him, Subaru-kun won't have to worry about anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのスバルくん、
の隣にレムちゃんがぴったりついてりゃ、
なんの心配もねぇさ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: So Rem... is the perfect fit...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムが……
ぴったり……？
……

text_block_list.name: Rem
